root_cause: The exact route required every detected code to occur in one chunk and forced an exact-only top-k even when a code matched multiple documents. This violated the predeclared ambiguity fallback contract and reduced the otherwise passing hybrid ranking.
remediation: Preserve detected code order and use the first explicit code as the lookup target.
Use the exact-only fast path only for one code, one document, and a bounded candidate set.
For ambiguous exact matches, fuse exact candidates with global BM25 and dense ranks and record the fallback reason.
Generate a new deterministic RC3 question holdout with selection offset 31; RC2 reports remain rejected evidence.
